detail: Neogen Chemicals Limited has raised ₹600 crore from a qualified institutional placement of equity shares. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised the Lead Managers, Inga Ventures Private Limited, IIFL Capital Services Limited and Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Limited, on this QIP. The transaction was led by Arka Mookerjee (Partner), with support from Pracheta Bhattacharya (Partner), Kairav Parikh (Partner), Associates Arika Gupta, Khushvi Kanungo and Yana Nazareth.
